description: A sprite sheet of TWELVE separate indoor furniture props arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each centered in its own cell. Row 1: a single wooden bed with a patchwork quilt and a white pillow, a small square wooden dining table, a simple wooden chair, a small cast iron cooking stove with a kettle. Row 2: a wooden storage chest with iron bands, a tall wooden wardrobe with two doors, a wooden bookshelf full of colorful books, a stone fireplace with a small fire. Row 3: a round woven rug seen from above, a small table lamp with a warm glowing shade, a round wooden wall clock, a framed landscape painting. Cozy rustic cottage furniture, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm wood tones, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no floor, no wall, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters
